summary: A Readymag one-pager for NN Knit Grotesk, a type family designed for hand knitting: the whole site is set in its dotted and striped styles in a strict orange / ultramarine / white scheme, with photos of knitted letter swatches, ticker-like section bands ('MADE FOR KNITTING', 'WEIGHTS', 'CHARACTER SET', 'STORY'), and a story that walks from Futura to a pixel grid to the knitted 'A'.

instances.look: 'KNIT / GROTESK' in white dotted capitals (Dot 1) filling the top 60% of a flat orange field, with an ultramarine-framed photo of knitted letter swatches starting below
instances.ux: Fixed orange header with the repeated name and a white 'FREE TRIAL PACKAGE' button; the photo under the name is an autoplaying slideshow
instances.learn: Set the wordmark in the dotted style so it already reads like stitches before the knitted photos confirm it

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed orange #fe4604; two lines 'KNIT' / 'GROTESK' from x≈30 to x≈1400, y≈60–530 (cap height ~210px); ultramarine frame from y≈540 with an inset photo (24px border)
reconstruction.typography: Name ~290px Knit Grotesk Dot 1 (light dotted outline) uppercase white, tight leading ~0.95
reconstruction.behaviour: White screen ~2s while Readymag loads; photo slideshow below autoplays (4 slides)

instances.look: A wide photo of red-and-white knitted swatches, each carrying a knitted capital (B, R, …) with loose yarn ends, framed by a thick ultramarine border
instances.ux: Readymag slideshow (4 slides, '2 / 4') cycling knitted pieces, including a blue/white diagonal knit close-up
instances.learn: Show the font's actual medium (knitted wool), not a screen mockup: the photo proves the purpose in one glance

reconstruction.layout: Ultramarine band ~900px tall; photo inset ~1380×460px with ~24px border; sits directly under the hero wordmark
reconstruction.typography: Type appears only inside the photographed knits
reconstruction.content: Photos by Linda Suter of knitted letter swatches
reconstruction.assets: 4 product photos of knitted swatches on white

instances.look: '→ KNIT ←' then 'GROTESK' repeated full width six times, each line in another style (Stripe, Dot, Stripe in a blue band, Dot in blue, …) in blue/white on orange, so the stack looks like a knitted colourwork band
instances.learn: Repeat one word in every style and alternate the colour of each band: the stack becomes a textile pattern and a style overview at once

reconstruction.typography: ~270px uppercase in Knit Grotesk Dot 1–3 and Stripe 1–3, two-colour (white and #151ca1) fills
